# AI Butler
> Personal AI agent runtime with multi-channel support, long-term memory, and swarm intelligence.

## Key Features
- Multi-channel: Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, Web, Terminal, LINE, IRC
- Long-term memory: Knowledge graph + FTS5 + vector search
- Swarm orchestration: Multi-agent task decomposition
- Agent ecosystem: A2A v2, MCP server, subprocess bridges
- Plugin system: WASM sandbox + marketplace
- Scheduled automation: Cron-based tasks
- Voice: STT + TTS pipeline
